## What is a Family Process Matrix?

A Family Process Matrix shows which process steps are used by each product family. It helps a team identify shared work, dedicated steps, branch points, bottlenecks, and opportunities to design a future-state value stream.

## Inputs and outputs

Start with a list of product families and the process steps each family follows. The completed matrix provides a visual grouping of similar flows that can inform value stream mapping (VSM), process ownership, and improvement priorities.

## Workflow

1. Review the [worked example](process-example.qmd).
2. Build and export a matrix in the [interactive workspace](process-primary.qmd).
3. Use the [next steps](process-next.qmd) to turn the matrix into a process plan.
